OpenAI published a case study on October 20, 2026 showing how ChatGPT Work handles daily admin. One independent franchisee used it for pricing analysis and cash reconciliation. 

 You will need to test the feature yourself with your own spreadsheets or transaction logs. Start by uploading a clean list of daily sales and bank deposits. Ask the model to flag mismatches and summarize the variance. Review the output before posting to your ledger. It is fast, but you still verify the final numbers.

Try this exact prompt with your own files:
"Match each bank deposit to the corresponding sales day. Flag any variance over five dollars. Summarize the daily balance."
